title: Refute Printed.sLocalCechBergman_reflection and Printed.sLocalCech_right_commutes (Theorem 5.4.2.2(3)–(5), p. 276)
body:
Proves two refutations in `RiemannMasullo/Ch05_ThetaZSpaces/Sec4_Printed.lean`. Only proofs and `private` helpers change. There is one new library import, `RiemannMasullo.Ch07_SchauderBasesZeta.Sec1a`, for `sLocalRhoFactor_poles_iff`. Nothing imports this file.

Closes #4810
Closes #4811

**`Printed.sLocalCechBergman_reflection_false`** (Theorem 5.4.2.2(3), p. 276). Take F = ℚ, S = ∅, χ = 1. The real place gives poles of ρ at `-p₁ - (2n + p₂)` for every n (`sLocalRhoFactor_poles_iff`). Choosing n large gives a pole s₀ with Re s₀ < 1. Take p = the Gaussian `exp(z²)` in B⁺ (`gaussian_mem_schwartzBergmanSubmodule`). Near s₀, ρ(s) = (J p)(s) / exp((1-s)²), which is analytic, so its meromorphic order is ≥ 0. That contradicts the pole. The pole is reached by taking n large rather than at s = 0 as in the docstring, so the parameters of the trivial character are never computed.

**`Printed.sLocalCech_right_commutes_false`** (Theorem 5.4.2.2(4)–(5), (5.4.2.6), p. 276). Take F = ℚ, S = ∅, χ = 1 and x = 0, with τ from `sIdeleQuotientNorm_exists_section`. M₁ and M₂ come from `existsUnique_sLocalDecayMellin`. Take g = M₂⁻¹(Gaussian). ρ has a pole, so its order is finite everywhere on ℂ, and its zeros are isolated. That gives a real r ∈ (0, 1/2) with ρ(r) ≠ 0. The printed identity at s = r then forces exp(r²) = exp((1-r)²), so r = 1/2, which is impossible. This uses `Q(s) = exp(s²)` and some r near 1/4 instead of the docstring's `exp((s−2)²)` at exactly 1/4, so the value ρ(1/4) is never needed.

`#print axioms` on both theorems gives `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes from upstream declarations that are still `sorry`: `sLocalRhoFactor_poles_iff`, `sLocalRhoFactor_meromorphic` and `existsUnique_sLocalDecayMellin`.

Checks run: `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch05_ThetaZSpaces.Sec4_Printed` (the module itself takes a few seconds), full `lake build`, `scripts/lint.sh` (ok). Signatures were compared for this module before and after: `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean` on each version, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`. No statement changed.

Not claimed: #4807, #4808, #4809. They need explicit zeta integrals or isotype elements over ℚ.
